interventions.speaker: CHAIR
interventions.who: the senior urologist who signs the decision
interventions.body: The prognosis is influenced by several documented factors. Favorable findings include a negative surgical margin, absence of seminal vesicle invasion, absence of lymphovascular invasion, and no lymph node metastasis. The preoperative PSA was elevated at 11. The surgical pathology indicated a Gleason 4+5 (ISUP grade group 5) and pT2c stage. Countervailing factors include the missing Gleason pattern and ISUP report from the biopsy, which widens uncertainty regarding the true tumor biology. The nodal status was documented as negative. The postoperative PSA and its subsequent trajectory are unknown due to missing follow-up information. Information regarding the postoperative PSA and its trajectory would significantly revise this prognosis. The fixed estimated horizon is 48.22 months. This represents expected follow-up without an event, not a known recurrence date. The sensitivity range is 36.17–60.28 months; its coverage has not been validated.
